BUPT TA Recruitment System API

BUPT TA Recruitment System JavaDoc

This API documentation covers the standalone Swing demo for the Teaching Assistant recruitment workflow. The code is organised around CSV persistence, role-specific dashboards, notification services, and explainable TA-to-job matching.

Core Areas

  • Application entry and UI: Main, LoginFrame, RegisterFrame, and the TA, MO, and Admin dashboard classes.
  • Data model: User, TAProfile, Job, Application, Notification, and MatchResult.
  • Persistence: FileStorage manages CSV-backed storage and deterministic seed data.
  • Workflow services: NotificationService, MatchingService, ScoringService, and admin recommendation helpers.
  • AI support: optional external provider classes sit behind the SkillScoringProvider interface while preserving a local rule-based fallback.
  • Regression tests: console-based test classes document expected behaviour without adding a third-party test framework.

How to Read This Documentation

Start with Main for the launch path, then review FileStorage for the CSV schema assumptions. The dashboard classes show user-facing workflows, while the service classes contain the most reusable logic.
